sngon 'gro phyir bsgyur la:༙ hūm̐:༙ bdag nyid rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ thugs srog hūm̐ las 'phros pa yi:༙ khro bo 'phros pas nam mkha' gang:༙ khro mo 'phros pas sa gzhi gang:༙ gnyis med 'phros pas bar snang gang:༙ yaksha me dbal skar ltar 'khrugs:༙ hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog:༙ sde brgyad tshogs rnams rab tu brlag:༙ dkyil 'khor mi ldan bgegs kyi tshogs:༙ lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la:༙ 'di ru ma 'dug rang sar dengs:༙ 'byung po at+tsu ta ya phaṭa:༙ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha ni hūm̐:༙ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐:༙ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐:༙ ā na ya ho:༙ bha ga ba te bidyā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa:༙ de nas mtshams gyer ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ bdag nyid rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ thugs las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros:༙ 'khor lo rdo rje phur pa'i gur:༙ gri gug ral gri la sogs pa'i:༙ mtshon cha rnam lnga rab tu 'khrugs:༙ ye shes me dpung chen po ni:༙ 'ur 'ur chem chem me sgra yis:༙ stong gsum gang bar 'bar bar bsgom:༙ me yi tsha tsha thu lu lu:༙ sde brgyad 'byung po'i snying la gzir:༙ lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du brlag:༙ dregs pa sde brgyad bgegs kyi tshogs:༙ bla med dkyil 'khor mi ldan rnams:༙ gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs:༙ gal te mi 'gro bar gcod na:༙ bdag nyid rdo rje drag rtsal gyis:༙ mtshon cha lnga yi rtse la skyon:༙ me 'ob chen po'i klong du bsregs:༙ khro chu khol ma'i nang du sbyar:༙ ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan:༙ chu srin gdug pa'i gre bar brdzangs:༙ lcags kyi sdig pa'i rwa bar gtems:༙ yaksha me dbal gyis rdul du rlog:༙ sde brgyad srog la hur thum dzaḥchings:༙ oṃ badzra padma tsakra tīkṣ+ṇa karma kī la ya dzwa la raṃ bi shwa kro ta hūm̐:༙ sod mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa:༙ de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni:༙ drag po'i lha tshogs dngos su mjal bar dmigs la:༙ hūm̐:༙

de nas 'dzab bsnyen byed pa ni:༙ dang po gtso bo la:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ shrī he ru ka artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐:༙ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa:༙ gnyis pa 'khor bsnyen ni:༙ oṃ a mi dhe wa:༙ badzra gu ru khroṃ ga ru ḍa ya mānta ka hya gri ba badzra pā ṇi bai ro tsa ni ha ri ni sa yaksha raksha badzra ratna padma karma badzra kī li kī la ya:༙ hūm̐ hūm̐:༙ hūm̐ hūm̐:༙ hūm̐ hūm̐:༙ hūm̐ hūm̐:༙ hūm̐ hūm̐:༙ badzra aṅku sha dza:༙ badzra pā sha hūm̐:༙ badzra spho ṭa baṃ:༙ badzra ghaṇḍe ho:༙ de nas dbyangs gsal sogs bzlas shing:༙ 'gal me lta bur bskor ba'i dmigs pa bya'o:༙ sa ma ya:༙ rgya rgya rgya:༙ de nas bdun pa tshogs bya ba ni:༙ bdud rtsi tshogs la gtor zhing 'di skad do:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐:༙ bighnan ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa:༙ ces lan gsum gyis bgegs rnams bskrad:༙ de nas bsangs sbyangs la 'di skad do:༙ hūm̐:༙ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas:༙ tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro:༙ raṃ 'phros me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs:༙ yaṃ 'phros rlung byung bag chags gtor:༙ khaṃ 'phros chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus:༙ de phyir raṃ yaṃ khaṃ zhes bya:༙

de nas byin brlab pa ni:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī:༙ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas:༙ byin gyis brlab phyir yi ge 'phros:༙ hūm̐ gis tshogs kyi rnam rtog sbyangs:༙ āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur:༙ oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang:༙ hrīḥyis thugs dam lha tshogs dgyes:༙ de phyir oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bya:༙ de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas:༙ gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams:༙ sku la sgrib sel mi mnga' yang:༙ 'gro rnams bsod nams gsag bya'i phyir:༙ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:༙ rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor 'dir:༙ padma nyi zla'i gdan mchog la:༙ mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs:༙ sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob:༙ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol:༙ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:༙ tshogs mchod zag med bdud rtsir gyur:༙ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:༙ de nas tshogs phud rim gsum byas te:༙ dang po 'bul ba 'di skad do:༙ hūm̐:༙ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das:༙ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku:༙ gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa la:༙ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul:༙ a la la te bzhes su gsol:༙ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol:༙ gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka padma kro ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha raṃ khā hi:༙ de nas bar pa bshags pa bya ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ rdo rje drag po'i lha tshogs la:༙ sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar:༙ gnyis 'dzin dbang gis bdag rgyud kyis:༙ mchog gi don dang 'gal ba bshags:༙ badzra sa ma ya ho:༙ tha ma bsgral mchod bya ba ni:༙ bdag nyid che mchog thod phreng rtsal du gsal la 'di skad do:༙ hūm̐:༙ che mchog rdo rje drag po thod phreng rtsal:༙ phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs:༙ g.yon pas phur bus dgra bgegs snying la gzir:༙

sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs:༙ bar chad byed pa'i dam sri 'byung po sogs:༙ rdul du rlogs la gzugs phung dbyings su sgrol:༙ ru dra'i lnga phung rtsad nas da chod cig:༙ gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka padma kro ta dgra bgegs sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa:༙ de nas bstab pa bya ba ni:༙ 'chams stabs bya zhing 'di skad do:༙ hūm̐:༙ rdo rje drag po'i lha tshogs rnams:༙ ri rab tsam gyi sku bzhengs la:༙ nyi zla tsam gyi spyan gzigs shig:༙ gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes la:༙ gangs ri tsam gyi mche gtsigs shig:༙ glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la:༙ dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus:༙ zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi:༙ mgul du stims shig ā rālli:༙ chos kyi dbyings su bzhes su gsol:༙ gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka padma kro ta dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la khā hi:༙ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi:༙ ma hā rakta la khā hi:༙ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi:༙ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi:༙ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi:༙ de nas slob mas rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du tshogs phud bteg la 'di skad do:༙ ho:༙ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol:༙ 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di:༙ gtsang dang mi gtsang gnyis 'dzin bral:༙ bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag:༙ rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol:༙ a la la ste bzhes su gsol:༙ zhes padma'i phyag rgyas blangs la 'di skad do:༙ e ma ho:༙ tshogs kyi 'khor lo gsang sngags rdzas:༙ 'di la rnam rtog bya mi rung:༙ dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung:༙ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol:༙ a la la ho:༙ de nas tshogs gzhan gral bzhugs rnams la spel nas smon lam gdab pa ni:༙ ho:༙ rnal 'byor mched lcam 'khor bcas kyis:༙ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams:༙ tshogs kyi 'khor lor rgyas btab ste:༙ bla med 'bras bu thob par shog:༙ ces smon lam gdab bo:༙ rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi dngos gzhi'i las rim bdun pa bdag thod phreng rtsal gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so:༙

sa ma ya:༙ rgya rgya rgya:༙ :༙ ྈྈྈྈྈ gsum pa rjes kyi las rim bdun pa ni:༙ lhag ma mchod bskul chad mdo bya:༙ bstan skyong rta bro'i cho ga bya:༙ bkra shis smon lam bsdu chog bya:༙ rjes kyi las rim bdun du bstan:༙ sa ma ya:༙ rgya rgya rgya:༙ de nas dang po lhag ma bran la 'di skad do:༙ hūm̐:༙ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu:༙ bla ma yi dam phud la dgyes:༙ bar du lhag mas mi brngan rgyu:༙ drag po'i bka' nyan lhag la rngams:༙ gnyis med gcig tu mi bsre rgyu:༙ chos rnams ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig:༙ de nas phud lhag bsre:༙ slob dpon gyis zhal chab bran nas:༙ tha ma kha chus mi bran rgyu:༙ khyod dang bdag gnyis tha tshig gcig:༙ bhyo:༙ dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams:༙ dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging chen dang:༙ 'bar ma ging dang lang ka'i bdag:༙ ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya'i tshogs:༙ 'bum phrag lhag sdud mkha' 'gro ma:༙ mdzes pa'i sku la 'jigs tshul ston:༙ me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba can:༙ dril bu g.yer kha'i ska rags bcings:༙ rin chen gzhong thogs gtor len ma:༙ rdo rje phra men pho nya'i tshogs:༙ bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la:༙ bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:༙ ma ma hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi:༙ de nas thugs dam bskul pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ dur khrod me dpung dmar nag klong:༙ rab tu 'jigs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:༙ gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas:༙ zil gnon khro bo khro mo'i tshogs:༙ las byed chos skyong srung ma rnams:༙ bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs:༙ bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du skul:༙ mdzod cig bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod:༙ sgrol cig dgra bgegs dam nyams sgrol:༙ hūm̐:༙ bdag nyid rdo rje drag po rtsal:༙ spyi gtsug ral pa'i skra gseb nas:༙ mkha' lding khyung chen thugs dam skul:༙ dpral ba khro gnyer mdzod spu'i dbus:༙ sku mchog 'gyur med pho brang nas:༙

mkhyen rab 'jam dpal thugs dam skul:༙ mgrin par padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus:༙ gsung mchog 'gag med pho brang nas:༙ rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskul:༙ thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten dbus:༙ thugs mchog 'gag med pho brang nas:༙ phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam skul:༙ lte ba chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus:༙ yon tan mtha' rgyas pho brang nas:༙ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam skul:༙ gsang gnas rdo rje rgya gram dbus:༙ mngon spyod drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas:༙ yaksha me dbal thugs dam skul:༙ drag po'i phrin las gdon bgegs gzir:༙ gnod byed 'byung po'i gshed du che:༙ lcags sdig nag po'i thugs dam skul:༙ hūm̐:༙ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba nas:༙ zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa:༙ badzra drag po'i thugs dam skul:༙ nga rgyal ri ltar spungs pa nas:༙ rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa:༙ ratna drag po'i thugs dam skul:༙ 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho nas:༙ dbang gi las rnams sgrub mdzad pa:༙ padma drag po'i thugs dam skul:༙ phrag dog rlung nag 'tshub dkyil nas:༙ mngon spyod las rnams sgrub mdzad pa:༙ karma drag po'i thugs dam skul:༙ hūm̐:༙ phyogs bcur sprul pa 'gyed mdzad pa:༙ mi bzad gtum chen me ltar 'bar:༙ khro bo bcu yi thugs dam skul:༙ hūm̐:༙ drag po'i thugs kyi sprul pa ni:༙ stong gsum 'jig rten kha lo bsgyur:༙ sras mchog rigs bzhi'i thugs dam skul:༙ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi ru:༙ 'gugs 'ching sdom dgyes las kun sgrub:༙ sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam skul:༙ phyi rim dur khrod gnas brgyad nas:༙ dam can bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs:༙ rnam 'gyur sna tshogs cir yang ston:༙ rngam pa'i gad rgyangs srid gsum g.yo:༙ hūm̐ phaṭa sgra chen 'brug ltar sgrog:༙ 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha zengs se zeng:༙ khyed rnams nus mthu dpa' skyed la:༙ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs:༙ rgyal bsen pho mo bdud kyi tshogs:༙
